question: What is the meaning of impacts on the environment in relation to use of substances?
description: Substances that have impacts on the environment are those that can cause serious harm to the environment, persist in the environment, have the ability to move through water or air, are toxic, cause damage to aquatic life, contribute to ozone depletion, and negatively affect recycling and material reuse processes.
